device.name: Rohde & Schwarz FSWP phase noise analyzer (rssd PNA class)

facts.text: The PNA class is the phase noise analyzer object of the repository; its constructor sets Model to 'FSWP'
INP:ATT? reads the mechanical input attenuation
INP:ATT <dB> sets the mechanical input attenuation, formatted without decimals
INST:LIST? returns the measurement channels as one comma-separated reply
A channel name in the INST:LIST? reply is quoted, so Set_Channel compares each entry with a quoted name
The channel names the clone knows are SAN, IQ, NR5G, LTE, WLAN, PNOISE, NOISE, SPUR, ADEM, DDEM, V5GT and AMPL
:SENS:FREQ:CENT? reads the center frequency of the measurement
The center frequency is written as ':SENS:FREQ:CENT <value> HZ'
:SENS:SWE:POIN? reads the number of trace points of a sweep
The number of sweep points is written as ':SENS:SWE:POIN <value>' with six decimals
SENS:SWE:TIME? reads the sweep or capture time
The sweep time is written in seconds and 0 selects the automatic sweep time
:SENS:SWE:TYPE? reads the sweep type, one of AUTO, SWE and FFT
DISP:TRAC:Y:RLEV? reads the reference level of the trace
The reference level is written as 'DISP:WIND:TRAC:Y:SCAL:RLEV <value> dBm'
INIT:CONT OFF selects a single sweep and INIT:CONT ON a continuous sweep
:INP:ATT:AUTO ON returns the input attenuation to automatic
The upstream wrapper queries *IDN? and splits the reply on ', ' into make, model, device and version
